about: C3 3rd owner: the critic's blocker 2 (fruit in the cabin). Phase c (no pressure), my car placed at the wharf market's ends and driven through its stalls and over what they spilled, six times, 38 to 58 km/h, W held; every frame, every piece within 4 m is tested against my car's body (lx within the half length, lz within the half width, above the floor and below the bonnet / roof / boot lid). node tools/play.mjs tools/plays/tail_cabin.json --size 1440x900 (NOIR_PORT=5343)

steps.eval: (() => { const C = G.scenes.ctx.flags.chase, sm = G.stage.part('smash'); window.__cab = { frames: 0, bad: 0, worst: null, n: 0 }; (function loop() { const me = C.my, S = me.spec, c = Math.cos(me.yaw), sn = Math.sin(me.yaw), gy = me.groundY || 0; let k = 0; for (const p of sm.pieces) { const dx = p.pos.x - me.pos.x, dz = p.pos.z - me.pos.z; if (Math.abs(dx) > 4 || Math.abs(dz) > 4) continue; const lx = dx * c - dz * sn, lz = dx * sn + dz * c, ly = p.pos.y - gy; const top = lx > 0.85 ? 1.0 : lx < -1.05 ? 1.05 : 1.55; if (Math.abs(lx) < S.halfL - 0.1 && Math.abs(lz) < S.halfW - 0.1 && ly > 0.4 && ly < top) { k++; if (!window.__cab.worst) window.__cab.worst = [p.name, +lx.toFixed(2), +ly.toFixed(2), +lz.toFixed(2), +me.speedAbs.toFixed(1)]; } } window.__cab.frames++; if (k) window.__cab.bad++; window.__cab.n = Math.max(window.__cab.n, k); if (!window.__cabStop) requestAnimationFrame(loop); })(); return 1; })()

steps.label: no piece ever inside my car's body (the cabin, the bonnet, the boot) through six ploughs of the wharf market
